pr_title: Fix daily challenge stats display suffix not displayed
pr_body:
- Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/29355

Almost forgot to fix this one before release. The new code may be a little too complicated, it just tries to preserve localisation of the number itself while arbitrarily adding "d"/"w" at the end. We can remove localisation from the number itself and simplify further but I think this is fine as-is.

issue_context.title: Daily challenge statistics display does not have suffixes
issue_context.body:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6cdfdbfc-9505-4289-9532-b7f73a6fda59)

The localisation strings `ShowDailyChallengeUnitDay` and `ShowDailyChallengeUnitWeek` appear to not have the suffixes added to them. cc @smoogipoo
comments: It's impossible for this to be handled with the way localisations currently work. We'll need to define osu!-specific localisation strings or use Humanizer instead.

review_comments: I don't think this is ever getting fixed 😅
We should add concrete localisations for these instead imo. Duplicate the osu!web ones for our purpose.
